Level 3 · Quality and Decisions

Level 3: Quality, Decisions and Evaluation

Turn vague goals into numbers, weigh options honestly and record the decisions your team will have to live with.

Open the courseSee pathways

Live online course US$199

Who it is for
Architects, senior engineers and tech leads who choose between designs and must defend the choice.
Before you start
Level 2, Mastering arc42, or equivalent experience writing architecture documentation.
Capstone evidence
One quality and decisions record built on top of your arc42 document.
How it is assessed
Quiz questions in every lesson and a lab with health checks across 20 sections. The certificate shows you finished the course.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your record.

ModuleWhat it coversEvidence
Quality in numbersTurn adjectives into scenarios, budgets and conflicts you can test.Quality tree, scenarios and budgets with numbers
Deciding wellDrivers, options, evidence and a record that lasts.Options compared against scenarios, with trade-offs
Structure for changeBoundaries, contracts and data that let the system change safely.Decision records a new team member can act on
Review and riskFind the weak spots before they ship.A review of a design against its own scenarios
Decisions in the AI eraUse AI to draft, and make decisions agents can follow.Decision notes that an AI agent can read

External mapping

Related published material, as references and optional pathways only.

Reference or frameworkHow we use it
ISO/IEC 25010:2023 quality modelUsed as the vocabulary for quality characteristics. Paid standard: we teach the ideas and do not reproduce the text.
ATAM (Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method)Scenario-based evaluation ideas from the Software Engineering Institute inform the review lessons. This is not an ATAM certification.

Level 3 teaches evaluation practice. It does not replace an independent review of your own architecture.
